title: A repeated workflow becomes a candidate procedure, and a counterexample stops it
narrative: The same expense workflow is used twice, then a counterexample arrives: the promoted procedure must carry its conditions and must not be applied where the counterexample holds.
todo_reason: Candidate-procedure promotion is not enabled in v0.1. docs/MEMORY.md records that the comparison here does not establish that its extra write cost is useful, so the assertion is written and the row stays todo until promotion lands.
